text:
Kestrelline Rail will build its new maintenance depot in Port Ansgar, the company announced on 14 March 2031.

The depot is budgeted at 412 million credits and will employ 1,150 staff once operational, according to the Kestrelline Rail Fleet Maintenance Expansion Plan, released at the company's spring investor briefing.

Maren Tolliver, Chief Infrastructure Officer of Kestrelline Rail, confirmed the Port Ansgar location at the briefing.

"Port Ansgar gives us the site we need to keep our fleet running reliably for years to come," Tolliver said. "This depot is a long-term commitment to the region and to the people who will work there."

The announcement formally settles the question of where the company will base the expansion set out in the plan. The document positions the depot as a central part of Kestrelline Rail's strategy to strengthen fleet maintenance capacity.

The creation of 1,150 positions is expected to be a significant addition to the local job market once the facility is running.
